reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin for creating isolated one-shot or persistent forked subagent conversations, with inherited context, tool execution, persistent logs, and an integrated side panel; its primary user-facing purpose is agent orchestration.

summaries.zh: 在不中断主会话的情况下创建一次性或可持续的隔离侧会话，并通过侧栏查看其对话、上下文和工具活动。
summaries.en: Create isolated one-shot or persistent side sessions without interrupting the main conversation, and view their messages, context, and tool activity in a side panel.

capabilities: Creates one-shot and persistent forked subagent sessions
Inherits completed parent-session turns as reference context
Displays subagent messages, reasoning, tool activity, and results in a side panel
Persists child-session history across DSH restarts
Can forward image attachments to side sessions
May invoke configured subagent tools, with an optional read-only tool allow-list
